subject: PathFinder POC: success metrics, owners, and week-1 pull
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Cho <ella@pathfinder.com>; Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@pathfinder.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-24T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Pathfinder discovery follow-up + suggested POC scope

Thanks for the time today — quick recap and a proposed 3-week POC to validate the integration and cost/latency fit. High level: 

Goal (what success looks like)
- 90th percentile inference latency < 250ms for our default batch size on sample traffic (50-100 reqs/min)
- Average generated response quality score >= 4.0 on your rubric (we'll use the 10-case prompt set you shared)
- Embedding similarity throughput to support real-time lookup at target QPS (demo crawl)

Proposed runbook (week-by-week)
- Week 0 (this week): get network + API keys in place, share sample prompts, confirm eval rubric & owner
- Week 1: integration + baseline metrics; Redwood SE to run initial validation; PF engineering to run 10 sample flows
- Week 2: optimization (batching, KV caching), run expanded prompt set, measure cost delta
- Week 3: acceptance run, readout, and decision checklist

Owners
- Redwood SE (hands-on): Ben Carter
- Redwood commercial / escalation: Jordan Blake (me)
- PF engineering lead: Samir Gupta
- PF product: Ella Cho (evaluation rubric owner)

Next steps (ask list)
1) Can you confirm owners listed above and the sample prompt set by EOD Monday?
2) Share the security checklist items we need to satisfy for a Private VPC test (we'll scope minimum needed)
3) Do you want Redwood to spin up a short-lived dedicated queue or start on hosted with traffic mirroring?

I've attached a lightweight POC checklist and a sample MOA. I can spin up a kickoff invite once owners are confirmed.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pathfinder-poc-checklist.xlsx (stub), redwood-poc-moa.pdf (stub)

From: Ella Cho <ella@pathfinder.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@pathfinder.com>
Date: 2027-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pathfinder discovery follow-up + suggested POC scope

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the clear plan. Confirming ownership: Ella (product) and Samir (eng) on our side. A couple clarifications and an alternate acceptance item we'd like to include:

Clarifications:
- Latency target: 250ms 90p is reasonable but can we measure both token-latency and end-to-end user-visible latency? We'll need both numbers for infra planning.
- For the quality metric: we'll run your 10-case rubric and an internal blind A/B on 100 cases if possible.

Addition to success criteria:
- No PII leakage: all model responses in the test must not surface customer PII for redacted inputs (we will provide redaction samples)

Security asks (high level):
- We'll need a diagram for network egress and token encryption in transit/storage
- SOC2 evidence and the KMS integration outline

We're good to start hosted for week-1, then evaluate Private/Dedicated if we need isolation. Attaching our sample prompt set and a short rubric doc. Kickoff on Tuesday next week works for Samir and me.

Best,
Ella
Ella Cho
Product Lead, Search Experience
PathFinder Inc

Attachments: PF-prompt-set.csv (stub), PF-eval-rubric.pdf (stub)

I'll take the SE lead for week-1 baseline and handle the hosted spin-up. Quick notes:
- I'll provision a test key and create a temporary API environment with traffic mirroring.
- Need PF to confirm an allowlist IP range and whether sampling will include attachments (affects tokenization).
- I'll run a short pre-flight: 20 prompt runs across short/long form to capture token-latency and E2E.

Calendar: slotting 2 hours Wed morning for integration with Samir. Attaching a short checklist I'll use to sign off week-1 baseline.

Ben
